title: Portfolio
subtitle: Public links to your work — websites, repos, design files, articles. SoloOS uses them to write cover letters that mention specific projects you've shipped.

how_it_works.title: How this works
how_it_works.body: Paste a public URL. SoloOS checks the link is reachable and viewable to anyone, then reads its content to summarise what's inside. Cover letters reference these links naturally — by name and product, not generic platitudes.

public_only.label: Public links only.
public_only.body: Links that require sign-in (private Figma files, locked GitHub repos, paywalled pages) can't be saved here — we need to be able to read them to make them useful.

examples.portfolio_body: Your own site — any URL that loads without a sign-in. Best when projects are clearly named.
examples.github_body: Public repositories. SoloOS reads the README, languages, and topics.
examples.figma_body: Set the file to 'Anyone with the link can view' in Figma before adding.
examples.article_body: Medium, Substack, dev.to, your own blog. Great for writers, PMs, engineers.
examples.app_body: Live products you've shipped — even better if you also link the source repo.

status.broken: We can't read this link anymore — re-check or replace it.
status.ready_for_letters: Ready to use in cover letters
status.off_for_letters: Off — not used in cover letters

issue.broken: the link can no longer be read. Re-check or replace it.
issue.pending: still being processed. Re-check in a moment.
issue.toggle_off: this link is turned off for cover letters — flip the toggle below to use it.
issue.generic_title: the file is called "Untitled" (or similar). Rename it in Figma to something specific.
issue.vague_summary: the summary looks like a guess from the filename ("likely contains design work"). Rename your file and frames descriptively in Figma, then re-check — or write the summary yourself with the pencil icon.
issue.no_summary: no AI summary yet. Open the file in Figma, set a representative thumbnail (right-click a frame → Set as thumbnail), then re-check.
issue.no_hint: no cover-letter hint. Edit with the pencil icon to tell the AI when to mention this link.
issue.sparse_thumbnail: the file's cover preview is nearly blank. In Figma, right-click your best frame → Set as thumbnail, then re-check.
issue.few_pages: the file only has one page. Multi-page files give the AI a clearer picture of the project's scope.
issue.few_named_frames: few frames have meaningful names — most are still "Frame 87", "Group 24". Rename your screens in Figma for richer summaries.
issue.no_named_frames: no frames have descriptive names. Renaming "Frame 1" → "Onboarding" is the single biggest thing you can do to improve this score.
issue.noisy_frames: this file has many frames but almost none are named ("Frame 145", "Frame 9543"). That's noise — it would feed wrong information into cover letters. Rename your frames in Figma to fix.
issue.no_components: no reusable components in the file. Adding components signals design-system thinking; not critical but helps for system-design roles.
issue.no_text_content: no text on the canvas. If this file is supposed to contain UI copy or product text, add it — Gemini reads it verbatim.
issue.placeholder_text: most text layers are placeholders ("01", "x", page numbers). Real UI copy gives the AI much more to work with — write actual content on the canvas, or remove the placeholders.
issue.signals_missing: we haven't analysed this Figma file's structure yet. Click the re-check icon to capture frame, component, and text counts — without that we can't score it honestly.
issue.api_locked: Figma's free-plan rate limit is currently blocking deep analysis of this specific file (separate from re-checking). We can see its cover but not its frames or components, so the score is conservative. The limit clears in a few days, or upgrading your Figma plan removes it.
issue.visualquality_missing: we haven't graded this file's cover yet. Click re-check to let Gemini look at the thumbnail and rate whether the cover shows real, specific design work — that's the signal that separates a polished file from a placeholder cover slide.
issue.cover_looks_blank: Gemini looked at the cover and saw mostly blank space or placeholder content — no identifiable product, screens, or UI. The score is capped accordingly. Open the file in Figma, right-click your best frame → Set as thumbnail, then re-check.
issue.analysis_pending: We couldn't analyze this file yet — Figma's free-plan rate limit on this specific file is active and may take up to 3 days to clear, and our AI fallback also didn't produce anything this attempt. You don't need to fix anything; the file is fine. Click re-check periodically — once the limit clears we'll capture the analysis automatically and the link will be ready to use.

tips.title: Tips for better results
tips.figma_thumbnail: Figma: right-click your best frame → Set as thumbnail. The system reads that image, so a representative cover dramatically improves the summary.
tips.figma_naming: Figma: rename pages and frames descriptively ("Onboarding" not "Frame 1"). Names are read alongside the thumbnail.
tips.github_readme: GitHub: make sure the repo README explains what the project does in the first paragraph — that's what the AI reads.
tips.edit_summary: If the auto-summary is off or generic, click the pencil icon and rewrite it yourself. Your text overrides the AI output and persists.
tips.quality_bar: The score bar on each card shows how confidently the AI can reference that link in your letters. Aim for Good or Great.

use_toggle.on_body: SoloOS may reference this when relevant to the role.
use_toggle.off_body: Won't appear in any generated letter while this is off.
use_toggle.locked_body: This link can't be used in cover letters until its score reaches {{threshold}}. Fix the issue above and re-check.
use_toggle.pending_body: Figma's free-plan rate limit on this file is active (can take up to 3 days). Once it clears we'll capture the analysis and the toggle becomes available.
use_toggle.aria: Use this link in cover letters

empty_summary.body: No summary yet — rename your pages and frames descriptively in Figma, then click re-check to refresh.
empty_summary.pending_body: Analysis pending — Figma's free-plan rate limit on this file is active. We'll auto-grade it as soon as the limit clears (up to a few days).
